in_sanskrit.name: Sanjesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God is victorious
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sanjesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sanjeesh is a Hindu name for a boy, derived from the Sanskrit word 'san' meaning 'god' and 'jeshth' meaning 'victorious'. It signifies that the god is victorious and bestows victory and strength upon the one bearing the name.

in_marathi.name: Sanjesh

It signifies that the god is victorious and bestows victory and strength upon the one bearing the name.
